concepts.statement_en: Given a household scene, identify a water, sanitation, food-safety, or waste concern and an appropriate partner/action.
Given a cough and treatment-support case, explain current TB service access and BHW follow-up role.
Given a household risk map and symptom case, choose prevention and escalation actions.
Given an animal-bite case, communicate the reviewed first response and urgent referral route.
Given an older-person household case, explain reviewed cough etiquette, prevention, and service options.
Given a misconception, explain a reviewed transmission/prevention distinction without stigma.
Given a flood-exposure concern, convey prevention and referral guidance from the current local protocol.
Given a changing local advisory, locate the current official response and communicate a safe household action.
In a locally relevant case, connect WASH prevention with a reviewed referral message.
In an endemic or travel-relevant case, identify a locally verified prevention and referral route.
Given a persistent skin-change concern, respond without stigma and direct to assessment.
In locally relevant cases, match each disease to its reviewed exposure-prevention and assessment pathway.
